why: Docs examples are compiled regions of the playground, so cards, charts and controls need one overview route that also exercises a global range and a bound and an overridden card.
what: apps/playground/src/routes/overview.tsx and tests/layout/overview.layout.test.ts (routeTree.gen.ts is gitignored). Created here, within the playground line ceiling set by v3-playground-reset.
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/**, other areas' migrations files
contract: Read concepts/skills-agent-layer.md 4.5 (regions) and concepts/controls-url-state.md section 6 (exemplar). Consume the public API only: basalt-ui/cards, basalt-ui/charts, basalt-ui/controls, basalt-ui/router.
exemplar: apps/playground/src/routes/cards.tsx (landed by v3-exemplar-statcard) for route and scenario layout.
change: Route /overview: a global range in the page controls via defineControls, StatGroup strip and StatCard row, two widget cards (one bound to the global, one with an override showing the cue), a ChartCard, a BarList and an EventList in a DataPanel, FilterSet with Filters (n) on phone. Mark regions // #region stat-card, stat-group, chart-card, filter-set, bar-list, data-panel for the generated docs. Rule: none. Skill: the regions. Test: the playground typecheck and a layout test reading the route's data-slots.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Real-Chrome layout test via tests/layout harness at 1440, 768, 390, 320; axe serious/critical none; at most 3 shot rounds at 1800x1200 and 390x844, dark and light, against docs/v3/inspo/x-reference.jpg.
acceptance: apps/playground typecheck passes and every region named above compiles
make gen-check is green: docs/stat-card.md and the other pages embed their region unchanged
layout at 1800x1200 and 390x844: no horizontal overflow, one card shows the override cue, Filters (n) appears below @narrow
the quality matrix includes the route and passes when qa-i4 has landed
the route imports only public basalt-ui subpaths (no relative path into packages/basalt-ui/src)
